planCardCss: .plan-card { background-color: #fff; border-radius: 12px; box-shadow: 0 4px 6px rgba(0,0,0,0.1); width: 400px; text-align: center; transition: transform 0.3s, box-shadow 0.3s; overflow: hidden; padding-bottom: 30px; height: 500px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; }
.plan-card .title { font-size: 20px; margin: 0; font-family: Averta, Lato; font-weight: 700; color: #fff; }

.plan-card .subtitle { background-color: #ededed; padding: 10px 0; font-family: Lato; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 700; line-height: 18px; color: #4d5761; height: 58px; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; }

.plan-card .badge { display: inline-block; margin-top: 24px; margin-bottom: 10px; padding: 5px 10px; color: #ff6338; border: 1px solid #ff6338; border-radius: 12px; font-size: 12px; font-weight: bold; }
.plan-card .price { font-size: 34px; line-height: 30px; font-weight: bold; color: #4d5761; font-family: Averta, Lato; }
.plan-card .choose-plan-btn { background-color: #ff6338; color: #fff; border: none; border-radius: 24px; padding: 10px 20px; font-size: 16px; width: 100%; height: 47px; font-weight: bold; }
note: A home WordPress e a LP HubSpot usam layouts diferentes. O grid com linhas Adesao/Troca/Taxa + hover borda laranja segue o print do parceiro; tokens de cor/fonte/botao sao os oficiais #FF6338.
